name: Collection transformation
meaning: An operation producing derived collection values rather than mutating the source.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Lazy sequence
meaning: A source of values processed as traversal requests them rather than eagerly materializing every intermediate collection.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Fold accumulator
meaning: The running result passed from one fold step into the next.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Comparator composition
meaning: Combining a primary ordering with subsequent tie-break keys.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Destructuring
meaning: Binding variables from componentN functions in declaration order.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Explicit encoding
meaning: Naming the character-to-byte mapping at a text I/O boundary.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Whole-input match
meaning: A pattern match that must cover the entire supplied input.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Zoned representation
meaning: A local calendar interpretation of an instant using a specified time zone.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: File-private declaration
meaning: A top-level private declaration accessible only inside its Kotlin source file.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Explicit dependency
meaning: A required source or library deliberately supplied and versioned by the build.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Unit-style check
meaning: A focused executable condition testing one behavior with an explicit failure message.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Failure context
meaning: Information locating a failed assumption while avoiding unnecessary disclosure of raw input.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Suspend function
meaning: A function callable from a suspending context that may suspend without inherently creating a thread.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Structured scope
meaning: A coroutine lifetime boundary that owns and waits for its child coroutines.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Deferred result
meaning: A coroutine result handle whose await operation retrieves successful completion or propagates failure.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Cooperative cancellation
meaning: A stop request observed at cancellation-aware points so work can release resources and finish.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Cold flow
meaning: A flow whose builder starts anew for each collection rather than running eagerly at declaration.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Coroutine mutex
meaning: A mutual-exclusion primitive whose contended lock acquisition can suspend a coroutine.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Platform type
meaning: A Java-interoperability type whose nullability is not fully specified to Kotlin.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Validation pipeline
meaning: A sequence of explicit conversion, acceptance and collection steps with a stated rejection policy.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.
